# Summary

Ph.D. student in photonics with hands-on silicon nitride (SiN) integrated photonics experience, from device design and FDTD simulation to Python-scripted layout, foundry-PDK tape-out, and optical measurement. Research spans programmable photonic circuits, optical inverse design, topological photonics, and quantum optics experiments.

# Research Experience

## SiN photonic integrated circuits

- Scripted the tape-out layout of topological unitary circuits in PhotonForge with the Ligentec SiN PDK for a foundry MPW run (chips in fabrication).
- Designed non-Abelian braiding devices with coupled-mode theory, verified them in Tidy3D FDTD, and characterized the fabricated passive circuits (manuscript in preparation).

## Quantum optics experiments

- Lead a five-member team (since 2025) running Hong–Ou–Mandel (HOM) experiments with SPDC photon pairs.
- Developing reinforcement-learning control of mirror alignment and path delay to maximize HOM visibility.

## Programmable photonic circuits for optical computing

- Co-invented a nonlinear unitary optical device (an MZI with resonator-coupled waveguides) for optical neural networks; KR patent registered, US/EP applications published.
- Co-first author of a review of programmable photonic unitary circuits (*Nanophotonics*, 2025).

## Optical inverse design

- Developed hypergraph compression of wave scattering that designs disordered optical materials with $O(N^{1/L})$ time complexity, beyond the conventional $O(N)$ limit (first author; \href{https://github.com/KunwooPark/Scattering-Hypergraph}{Python code}).
- Co-developed network-based inverse design of multiphase and non-Hermitian media (*Adv. Opt. Mater.* 2026).

# Skills

- **Layout and tape-out:** PhotonForge, gdsfactory, KLayout; Ligentec SiN PDK, MPW tape-out
- **Simulation and modeling:** Tidy3D (FDTD), COMSOL; coupled-mode theory, scattering-matrix models
- **Programming:** Python (layout, simulation, experiment automation); agentic coding (Claude Code, Codex)
- **Measurement:** passive SiN circuit testing; SPDC photon pairs, SPAD/TCSPC coincidence counting
